headlines.title: Zacks.com featured highlights include APA, T-Mobile, BP and Centene
headlines.summary: As market volatility intensifies the value-versus-growth debate, APA and three other GARP stocks combine attractive valuations with sustainable earnings growth potential.

headlines.title: How T Mobile Loss Will Impact Amdocs Stock
headlines.summary: Amdocs reported Q4 and full-year fiscal 2026 results broadly in line with guidance, with revenue of $1.19b up 3.8% year on year and earnings of $1.98 per share matching analyst expectations, while issuing fiscal 2027 guidance that points to revenue and profit declines tied to a dispute and potential contract loss with T-Mobile.

headlines.title: Amdocs (DOX), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
headlines.summary: Amdocs (DOX) just released Q4 and full year fiscal 2026 results that aligned with prior guidance, while its fiscal 2027 outlook indicated weaker revenue and profit expectations related to issues with T-Mobile. Amdocs shares have climbed recently, with a 30 day share price return of 7.42% and a 90 day share price return of 12.91%. However, the year to date share price return is down 22.12% and the 1 year total shareholder return has declined 22.

headlines.title: T Mobile US (TMUS) Cuts Phishing Risk And Debuts T Mix And New Fiber
headlines.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS:TMUS) announces a broad cybersecurity overhaul that sharply reduces phishing and SIM swap attacks across its network. The carrier details new network-level protections that apply automatically to customer accounts, targeting account takeover and fraud attempts. Management also rolls out new T-Mix wireless plans that allow customers to customize features and pricing tiers to their usage needs.

headlines.title: Deutsche Telekom Said to Hit Brakes on T-Mobile Merger
headlines.summary: Bloomberg's Michelle Davis joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Deutsche Telekom's plans to combine with its American arm T-Mobile have hit a snag, people familiar with the matter said, casting doubt on what would be the largest-ever public merger.

description: T-Mobile US, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides wireless communications services in the United States, Puerto Rico, and the United States Virgin Islands. The company offers voice, messaging, and data services to postpaid, prepaid, and wholesale and other services customers. It also provides wireless devices, including smartphones, wearables, tablets, home broadband gateways, headsets, and other mobile communication devices, as well as accessories; financing through equipment installment plans; reinsurance for device insurance policies and extended warranty contracts. The company offers services under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile brands through its owned and operated retail stores, customer care channels, national retailers, and its websites, as well as through T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile apps. It also sells devices to dealers and other third-party distributors for resale through independent third-party retail outlets and various third-party websites. It has 700 MHz wireless spectrum licenses. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. T-Mobile US, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom AG.
